# TabBar

The app's lilac tab bar: icon and label per tab; a wave crest rises over the chosen tab and glides between tabs.

<!-- rules:start — GENERATED by tools/build_tokens.py from design/components.json -->
## Rules (every product)

- The chosen tab: crest, purple icon, bold purple-ink label (never colour alone).
- Top edge stroked in bar.line.

Tokens: `component.bar` (fill, line, ink, brand, tab-ink, tab-ink-selected, tab-icon-selected, wave, crest) in design/tokens.json.

| Product | Implementation |
|---|---|
| Website | none: The website has no tabs. |
| Design System | `.fmt-tabbar`, `<TabBar>` |
| App | `FmtTabBar` |
